examples.description: Broker a fullmakt binding an agent principal to a company delegation

description: Broker a fullmakt — scoped, revocable company→agent authority via an Altinn systembruker. Brokers and persists the delegation, binding the returned system_user_id write once onto the principal (pending to active); the company's signing authority must approve the returned `delegation_url` before it is usable. Non-empty `warnings[]` on a 201 means a local follow-up degraded: reconcile, never blind retry. Identical retries are dedup safe. Inputs: { agent_principal_id (YOUR OWN), org_number, scopes[], validity_days?, label? }. Agent principals cannot yet be created through the public API. Failure modes: FULLMAKT_PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND, FULLMAKT_PRINCIPAL_NOT_ELIGIBLE, FULLMAKT_UPSTREAM_FAILED, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:altinn` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). To inspect the recorded state, use check_fullmakt; to withdraw it, use revoke_fullmakt. No sandbox mirror; returns SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE under a sandbox bearer. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/fullmakt
description_nb: Formidle en fullmakt: juridisk forankret, avgrenset og gjenkallelig myndighet fra selskap til agent via en systembruker i Altinn. Delegeringen formidles og lagres, og system_user_id knyttes én gang til principalen (`pending` blir `active`); selskapets signaturberettigede må godkjenne `delegation_url`. En `warnings[]` som ikke er tom på 201: avstem, gjenta aldri i blinde; identiske kall er idempotente. Agentprincipaler kan ennå ikke opprettes gjennom det offentlige grensesnittet. Lesesiden er check_fullmakt; tilbakekallingen er revoke_fullmakt. Krever read:altinn. Ingen sandkassespeil; under en sandkassenøkkel returneres SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.

agent_principal_id.description: The agent principal (UUID) to bind this delegation to — one of YOUR OWN; an unknown or foreign id returns FULLMAKT_PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND.

label.description: Optional consumer-supplied label for the delegation (dashboard display only; echoed back on the response).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer of the customer company granting the delegation. Plain 9 digits (no MOD-11 check), matching the route contract.

scopes.description: The Altinn scopes the delegation should carry (e.g. `altinn:accessmanagement/authorizedparties.read`); at least one, each non-whitespace.

validity_days.description: Optional delegation validity window in days (1–3650; the 10-year cap matches Altinn's longest supported term). Omit to use the adapter default.

name: request_fullmakt

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The brokered delegation: `system_user_id`, `status`, `scopes`, `valid_until`, `delegation_url` (the approval link), the echoed `label`, the `agent_principal` snapshot, and `warnings[]` (empty on the clean path).

title: Request a fullmakt (broker a systembruker delegation)
